title: lava db:new --json
description: Writes a migration file with the next timestamp. The name IS the ordering, so the command owns it and the caller does not type it — two people generating migrations on separate branches cannot collide on a number they were both told to increment.

name.description: The migration's name: <YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS>_<snake_case_description>. Null only when the invocation was refused, in which case no file was written.

file.description: Absolute path of the file written. Null when the invocation was refused.

table.description: The table the generated migration creates and drops, when the description followed `create_<table>_table`. Null for any other description — the file is then a commented template, not a guess at which column of which table was meant.

is_empty.description: True when the generated up() is an empty body with a commented example — the caller has to open the file and describe the change. False when the migration is already working and reversible.
